_readme: SAP Customer Data Platform pack knowledge (target role). Only keys starting with target_ reach a run's merged knowledge when the pack is bound as target (common.knowledge); the other keys are reference lists for analysts and the standard critic, read from this file directly.

Every entry is backed by a reference-cache.md row (Id in brackets) verified on 2026-10-05 through the help.sap.com content service unless marked (verify). CDP is a continuously delivered cloud service without version numbers: re-check dated entries.
No client content: lists describe the product, never a client's tenant.
target_api_endpoint_families: Base URL https://cdp.<dc>.gigya.com/ (data centers EU5, US5) [API-1, DR-2]
POST /api/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/applications/{applicationId}/dataevents/{dataEventId}/event - ingest one event by event id [API-1]
POST /api/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/applications/{applicationId}/dataevents/{dataEventId}/events - ingest several events by event id [API-1]
POST /api/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/applications/{applicationId}/external/{externalId}/event(s) - ingest by event name; JSON or XML; 202 + empty body (asynchronous) [API-1, API-2]

GET /api/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/views/{viewId}/customers and POST /query/v1/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/views/{viewId}/customers - SQL-like query, cursor paging (max 1000, 5 min cursor), purposeIds mandatory [API-4, API-5]
POST /api/v2/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/views - add the Contextual Profile view [IDR-3]
DELETE /api/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/activities - delete up to 100 activities, asynchronous [API-8]
Audit Service search and configuration APIs (workspace level, 2-year retention) [API-9]
UploadProductCatalog API (product catalog for accelerators) (verify endpoint)
OAuth 2.0 token https://oauth2.<dc>.gigya.com/oauth2/token, client-credentials flow; no refresh token, introspection or revocation [API-3]
Event listener (webhook) URL per configured event - generated by CDP, POST only for Connector Studio webhooks [COM-4, EXT-3]
Pre-mapping extension: CDP POSTs a JWT-signed request to customer-hosted code (issuer https://fidm.gigya.com/jwt/{businessUnitId}/) [EXT-7]
target_content_component_types: Business unit - variant Legacy or SAP Integrated, fixed at creation [ARCH-1, SCH-1]
Business area (area-defining attribute on profile, group or activity schema) [BA-1]
Profile schema / Group schema (organization, family account, device) / Relationship schema / Activity schema / Product schema [SCH-1..SCH-11]
Profile views: Unified Customer Profile (default) and Contextual Profile (optional) [IDR-2, IDR-3]
Application identifier, matching rule (system cdpId, user-defined, weak), merge rule (data quality rank, array max, conflict policy) [IDR-1..IDR-10, MRG-1..MRG-3]
Processing purpose (inbound and outbound data governance, static or dynamic) [PUR-1..PUR-8]
Indicators: activity, calculated (incl. child, RFM, RFE, recurring date, percentile), predictive (churn, CLV, TCLV, propensity) [ARCH-5, LIM-3..LIM-7, B2B-3]
Exploration, audience activation, lookalike audience [ACT-1, ACT-2, LIM-18]
CX flow (triggers, actions, decisions, flow controls incl. Enrich with Parent Data) and CX journey with milestones [ACT-3, ACT-4, B2B-1]
Application (preintegrated, custom via Connector Studio, direct/server application, web client application) with events (inbound) and actions (outbound) [INT-3, EXT-1, EXT-11, EXT-12]
Export configuration (Parquet to cloud storage), data retention rule, Direct Data Access purpose view (Advanced Insights add-on) [ACT-5, LIM-15, DDA-1]

standard_connectors.name: SAP Commerce Cloud
standard_connectors.prerequisite: SAP Commerce Cloud 2211 September 2024 update; Commerce side = SAP One Domain Model Integration (sapodmservices, sapodmfacades, sapodmbackoffice), consumed destinations odmCustomer/Order/CartDestination, outbound sync cron jobs for the initial load
standard_connectors.limits: Commerce-side replication documented for B2C customers, orders and carts; no write-back to Commerce; promotions opt-in

standard_connectors.name: SAP Commerce Cloud (Legacy)
standard_connectors.mode: scheduled polling via a CPI integration package on the customer's SAP Cloud Integration tenant

standard_connectors.name: SAP Commerce Cloud segments consumption (SAP Personalization Connectivity)
standard_connectors.limits: logged-in users only; segments also created manually in Commerce

standard_connectors.name: SAP Customer Data Cloud
standard_connectors.mode: scheduled batch (full accounts, groups, group relationships, lite accounts) + real-time listeners (account, 5 activities); CX-flow actions create/update accounts
standard_connectors.limits: one CDC application per business unit (several sites possible); do not share a CDC site across business units; API key fixed

standard_connectors.name: SAP Emarsys
standard_connectors.mode: streaming (opt-ins, contacts, accounts/relationships) + event listeners (6 engagement activities) + audience/CX-flow actions
standard_connectors.limits: one application per Emarsys tenant; tenant connects to CDP or CDC, not both; WSSE deprecated end of 2026; opt-ins via marketing.* purposes

standard_connectors.name: SAP Engagement Cloud, enterprise edition
standard_connectors.mode: as SAP Emarsys; data activation run required for automatic actions
standard_connectors.limits: several enterprise-edition tenants from one business unit need a support ticket

standard_connectors.name: SAP S/4HANA
standard_connectors.mode: real time via SAP Cloud Integration package
standard_connectors.limits: 512 KB events (BP 1 MB); no deletes; BP and relationship iFlows not shipped

standard_connectors.name: SAP Master Data Integration service
standard_connectors.mode: batch Business Partner person / organization / relationship

standard_connectors.name: Cloud storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP)
standard_connectors.direction: inbound file import; exports in Parquet

limits._readme: published limits per business unit unless stated; ids point at reference-cache.md
limits.schema: name 50 chars, field name 19 chars, 350 fields per schema, 35 activity types, 75 group types, nesting 4 [SCH-3]
limits.matching_rules: 30 per business unit; 20 profiles per value; lifetime 400 entities per value and 200 values per entity [IDR-6, IDR-8, IDR-9]
limits.segments: 100 segments / 200 values per business unit; 50 conditions per segment [LIM-1, LIM-2]
limits.indicators: 200 activity, 200 calculated, 50 predictive, 10 order-by per business unit [LIM-3..LIM-6]
limits.relationships: per profile or group max 100 groups and 20 per group type [SCH-11]
limits.arrays: default 10, max 50 values per array attribute; 3 searchable object arrays per business unit; 300 items per array in events [MRG-2, LIM-8, API-1]
limits.ingestion_api: event 40 KB, batch 500 KB, 100 activities per payload, string 10 KB, 200 single / 10 batch requests per second [API-1]
limits.packages: JSON, max 3 MB, one import per business unit at a time [ENV-2]
limits.exports: 50 configurations per business unit, one running at a time, fair use about weekly [ACT-5, ACT-6, LIM-12]
